name: tritoncha
description: Live-coding electronic music and 3D WebGL visuals studio built with ClojureScript, Rust WASM DSP and Three.js.
author: Alexandr Timchenko

scripts.watch:rust: cargo watch -C crates/tritoncha-dsp -s 'cargo test && pnpm run build:wasm'
scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --manifest-path crates/tritoncha-dsp/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && mkdir -p public/wasm && cp crates/tritoncha-dsp/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/tritoncha_dsp.wasm public/wasm/
scripts.build: pnpm run build:wasm && shadow-cljs release app
scripts.compile: pnpm run build:wasm && shadow-cljs compile app
scripts.test: pnpm run test:rust && pnpm run test:clj
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:rust && pnpm run lint:clj
scripts.fmt: pnpm run fmt:rust && pnpm run fmt:clj
scripts.fmt:check: pnpm run fmt:rust:check && pnpm run fmt:clj:check
scripts.check: pnpm run fmt:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test
